queries.description: Verify the continuous-learning skill can be activated
queries.query: Use the continuous-learning skill to evaluate the current session
queries.expected: The skill should load and provide instructions for session evaluation

queries.query: Run the session evaluator script on a sample session transcript
queries.expected: The script should detect patterns and save learned skills

queries.query: Check that config.json contains valid settings for the continuous-learning skill
queries.expected: Config should have min_session_length, learned_skills_path, and auto_approve settings

queries.description: Verify learned skills are created in the correct location
queries.query: After running the evaluator, check that learned skills were saved to the learned skills path
queries.expected: Learned skill directories should exist with SKILL.md files
